description: This file defines the ConfigFactory class in Drupal, responsible for creating, caching, and managing configuration objects, including handling overrides, cache invalidation, and event subscriptions related to configuration changes.

classes.name: ConfigFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing configuration objects, with caching, override handling, and event subscription capabilities.

methods.name: getEditable
methods.description: Returns an editable configuration object for the given name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a configuration object for the given name.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create a configuration object, applying overrides and cache.

methods.name: loadMultiple
methods.description: Loads multiple configuration objects by their names.

methods.name: doLoadMultiple
methods.description: Internal method to load multiple configuration objects with caching and override application.

methods.name: loadOverrides
methods.description: Retrieves configuration overrides from modules for specified configuration names.

methods.name: propagateConfigOverrideCacheability
methods.description: Propagates cacheability metadata of overrides to cached configuration objects.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears cached configuration objects, optionally for a specific name.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a configuration object, updating cache and dispatching events.

methods.name: getCacheKeys
methods.description: Returns cache keys related to configuration overrides.

methods.name: getConfigCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a configuration object based on its name and mutability.

methods.name: getConfigCacheKeys
methods.description: Returns all cache keys matching a configuration name.

methods.name: clearStaticCache
methods.description: Clears the static cache of configuration objects.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all configuration items from storage with an optional prefix.

methods.name: onConfigSave
methods.description: Updates cache entries when a configuration is saved.

methods.name: onConfigDelete
methods.description: Removes cache entries when a configuration is deleted.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to for configuration changes.

methods.name: addOverride
methods.description: Adds a configuration factory override object.

methods.name: createConfigObject
methods.description: Creates a new configuration object, either mutable or immutable.
